shortDescription: Creates a bulk operation task to remove agents from a group.

options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: criteria
options.description: Specifies the criteria you wish to filter agents on. The criteria is used to narrow down the list of agents to perform the specified action on.

options.name: group_id
options.description: ID of the group. Use the list_groups module to retrieve the groups in your organization. Is you need the group_id of a scanner, use the list_scanner_groups module.

options.name: items
options.description: An array of agent IDs or agent UUIDs to add to the criteria filter.

options.name: not_items
options.description: An array of agent IDs or agent UUIDs to exclude from the criteria filter.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.
